Mỗi 0,5ml vắc xin (kháng nguyên bề mặt, bất hoạt) chứa: 
A/Missouri/11/2025 (H1N1)pdm09-like strain (A/Missouri/11/2025, IVR-279) 15 µg haemagglutinin, A/Darwin/1454/2025 (H3N2)-like strain
(A/Michigan/105/2025, SAN-049A) 15 µg haemagglutinin, B/Tokyo/EIS13-175/2025-like strain
(B/Tokyo/EIS13-175/2025, wild type) 15 µg haemagglutinin
